answer: WITH agg AS ( SELECT a.accindex AS accindex, COUNT(DISTINCT s.sessref) AS session_count, SUM(c.postfreq) AS total_post_frequency, 0.4 * json_extract(sd.detection_score_profile, '$.overall.riskval') + 0.3 * (1 - ma.trustval) + 0.3 * ma.impactval AS srs, t.ipcountrynum AS ipcountrynum FROM account a JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey JOIN contentbehavior c ON c.cntsessref = s.sessref JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref JOIN messaginganalysis m ON m.msgcntref = c.cntref JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = t.techkey JOIN moderationaction ma ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey GROUP BY a.accindex ) SELECT accindex, session_count, total_post_frequency, 1 AS platform_count, srs * (1 + 0.2 * ipcountrynum) AS cpri FROM agg WHERE session_count > 1000 OR total_post_frequency > 50 ORDER BY cpri DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH nic AS ( SELECT a.accindex AS accindex, 0.4 * json_extract(n.network_engagement_metrics, '$.connection_metrics.connqualscore') + 0.3 * ma.netinflscore + 0.3 * json_extract(n.network_engagement_metrics, '$.interaction_metrics.interactdiv') AS nic_score FROM account a JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey JOIN contentbehavior c ON c.cntsessref = s.sessref JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref JOIN messaginganalysis m ON m.msgcntref = c.cntref JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = t.techkey JOIN moderationaction ma ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey ), ranked AS ( SELECT accindex, nic_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY nic_score DESC) AS influence_rank FROM nic WHERE nic_score > 0 ) SELECT accindex, ROUND(nic_score, 2) AS nic_score, influence_rank FROM ranked ORDER BY influence_rank LIMIT 10;

WITH tei AS ( SELECT a.accindex AS accindex, 0.4 * t.vpnratio + 0.3 * (t.proxycount / 10.0) + 0.3 * (t.ipcountrynum / 20.0) AS tei_value, t.ipcountrynum AS country_count FROM account a JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey JOIN contentbehavior c ON c.cntsessref = s.sessref JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref JOIN messaginganalysis m ON m.msgcntref = c.cntref JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = t.techkey JOIN moderationaction ma ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey ), q AS ( SELECT accindex, tei_value, country_count, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY tei_value) AS tei_quartile FROM tei ) SELECT accindex, ROUND(tei_value, 2) AS tei_value, country_count, tei_quartile FROM q WHERE tei_value > 0.8 AND country_count >= 3 ORDER BY tei_value DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH amp AS ( SELECT a.accindex AS accindex, a.platident AS platident, ma.netinflscore AS netinflscore, c.postfreq AS postfreq FROM account a JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey JOIN contentbehavior c ON c.cntsessref = s.sessref JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref JOIN messaginganalysis m ON m.msgcntref = c.cntref JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = t.techkey JOIN moderationaction ma ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey WHERE ma.clustrole = 'Amplifier' AND ma.coordscore > 0.8 AND ma.netinflscore > 80 AND c.postfreq > 30 ), cl AS ( SELECT platident, COUNT(DISTINCT accindex) AS member_count FROM amp GROUP BY platident ), ranked AS ( SELECT amp.accindex AS accindex, amp.netinflscore AS netinflscore, amp.postfreq AS postfreq, cl.member_count AS member_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amp.netinflscore DESC) AS influence_rank FROM amp JOIN cl ON cl.platident = amp.platident ) SELECT accindex, netinflscore, postfreq, member_count, influence_rank FROM ranked WHERE influence_rank <= 10 ORDER BY influence_rank LIMIT 100;

WITH base AS ( SELECT ma.clustsize AS clustsize, a.accindex AS accindex, 0.4 * json_extract(sd.detection_score_profile, '$.behavior_scores.botlikscore') + 0.3 * json_extract(sd.detection_score_profile, '$.behavior_scores.autobehavscore') + 0.3 * (1 - m.convnatval) AS bbi FROM account a JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey JOIN contentbehavior c ON c.cntsessref = s.sessref JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref JOIN messaginganalysis m ON m.msgcntref = c.cntref JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = t.techkey JOIN moderationaction ma ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey ) SELECT clustsize, ROUND(AVG(bbi), 2) AS avg_bbi, COUNT(DISTINCT accindex) AS account_count FROM base WHERE clustsize > 10 GROUP BY clustsize HAVING AVG(bbi) > 0.7 ORDER BY avg_bbi DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.accindex AS account_id, ma.reputscore AS reputation_score, ma.abuserepnum AS abuse_report_count, ma.lastrevdate AS last_review_date FROM account a JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey JOIN contentbehavior c ON c.cntsessref = s.sessref JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref JOIN messaginganalysis m ON m.msgcntref = c.cntref JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = t.techkey JOIN moderationaction ma ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey WHERE a.acctstatus = 'Dormant' AND ma.reputscore < 30 ORDER BY ma.abuserepnum DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT a.accindex AS account_id, json_extract(n.network_engagement_metrics, '$.engagement_metrics.engauth') AS engauth, json_extract(n.network_engagement_metrics, '$.interaction_metrics.tempinteractpat') AS tempinteractpat, 'Manipulator' AS status FROM networkmetrics n LEFT JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessref = n.netsessref LEFT JOIN profile p ON p.profkey = s.sessprofref LEFT JOIN account a ON a.accindex = p.profaccref WHERE json_extract(n.network_engagement_metrics, '$.engagement_metrics.engauth') < 0.3 AND json_extract(n.network_engagement_metrics, '$.interaction_metrics.tempinteractpat') = 'Automated' LIMIT 100;

WITH dormant AS ( SELECT a.accindex AS accindex, 0.4 * json_extract(sd.detection_score_profile, '$.behavior_scores.botlikscore') + 0.3 * json_extract(sd.detection_score_profile, '$.behavior_scores.autobehavscore') + 0.3 * (1 - m.convnatval) AS bbi FROM account a LEFT JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex LEFT JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey LEFT JOIN contentbehavior c ON c.cntsessref = s.sessref LEFT JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref LEFT JOIN messaginganalysis m ON m.msgcntref = c.cntref LEFT JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey LEFT JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = t.techkey WHERE a.acctstatus = 'Dormant' ) SELECT accindex AS account_id, bbi, CASE WHEN bbi > 0.9 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN bbi > 0.3 THEN 'Moderate Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END AS risk_level FROM dormant WHERE bbi > 0.2 ORDER BY bbi DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH farms AS ( SELECT c.cntref AS cntref, 0.4 * (1 - c.cntuniqscore) + 0.3 * c.mediareratio + 0.3 * (1 - m.txtuniq) AS cms, c.postfreq AS postfreq FROM contentbehavior c JOIN messaginganalysis m ON m.msgcntref = c.cntref WHERE 0.4 * (1 - c.cntuniqscore) + 0.3 * c.mediareratio + 0.3 * (1 - m.txtuniq) > 0.7 AND c.postfreq > 50 ), ranked AS ( SELECT cntref, cms, postfreq, CASE WHEN postfreq > 50 THEN 'High' WHEN postfreq >= 20 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS frequency_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cms DESC) AS manipulation_rank FROM farms ) SELECT cntref, cms, postfreq, frequency_category, manipulation_rank FROM ranked WHERE manipulation_rank <= 10 ORDER BY manipulation_rank LIMIT 100;

WITH base AS ( SELECT a.accindex AS accindex, 0.4 * json_extract(sd.detection_score_profile, '$.behavior_scores.botlikscore') + 0.3 * json_extract(sd.detection_score_profile, '$.behavior_scores.autobehavscore') + 0.3 * (1 - m.convnatval) AS bbi, (s.sesscount * 1.0) / a.acctagespan AS aaf, SQRT(POWER(json_extract(n.network_engagement_metrics, '$.connection_metrics.followgrowrate'), 2) + POWER(json_extract(n.network_engagement_metrics, '$.connection_metrics.followinggrowrate'), 2)) AS ngv, json_extract(sd.detection_score_profile, '$.behavior_scores.botlikscore') AS lbs FROM account a JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey JOIN contentbehavior c ON c.cntsessref = s.sessref JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref JOIN messaginganalysis m ON m.msgcntref = c.cntref JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = t.techkey JOIN moderationaction ma ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey ) SELECT accindex, ROUND(0.4 * bbi + 0.4 * aaf + 0.2 * ngv, 2) AS bas, lbs FROM base WHERE lbs > 70 ORDER BY 0.4 * bbi + 0.4 * aaf + 0.2 * ngv DESC LIMIT 10;
